question: May I push the six stack branches (mono/0-baseline-fixes … mono/5-ci) to ealush/ah so Xcode Cloud can build them? Never main; the first signed archive would be a manual Xcode Cloud run of mono/5-ci, uploaded as build 54 to the existing app's internal TestFlight group.

options.label: Push branches only (Recommended)
options.description: git push of the 6 branches to ealush/ah, no PRs opened, main untouched. Enough for Xcode Cloud to build and upload to TestFlight.

options.label: Push + open stacked PRs
options.description: Also run gh stack submit to open the 6 stacked PRs on ealush/ah (draft), with the verification results in their descriptions.

options.label: Don't push yet
options.description: I stop here; nothing goes to GitHub or TestFlight. The workflow can't be verified until the code is on ealush/ah.
